section.safeText: Dry run is on. No Claude files can be deleted.
section.safeHint: Every app launch starts here. Real deletion can be armed only for the current app session; it is never saved, and it returns to Safe Mode after one delete, after 10 minutes, or when the app closes.
section.armedText: Permanent deletion is enabled for this app session. Closing the app returns to Safe Mode.
section.guardsNote: Arming only switches dry run off. Every delete still needs a valid, unexpired, unchanged plan, exact paths inside approved Claude roots, no workspace or link escape, no running Claude Desktop or live session, and the typed DELETE confirmation.
section.hideNote: Hide session never touches Claude files and works in both modes.
